name: FinRobot
description: Financial analysis agent platform with a desktop research workstation, an equity report web app and an educational AutoGen library.
whatItDoes: Produces equity research, valuation and financial analysis reports for analysts and students. The repository holds three generations: a desktop workstation, a self-hosted report generator and the original multi-agent library.
howItWorks: The desktop product pairs a FastAPI and PydanticAI backend with a React and Tauri front end and pulls data from several market data providers with failover. Figures are computed deterministically and the LLM is used for narration; the earlier generations use the OpenAI Agents SDK and AutoGen.
